# CultureBot

> CultureBot is an AI-powered employee engagement and recognition platform for Slack and Teams that automates celebrations, peer recognition, and internal communications to build scalable team culture.

CultureBot helps companies strengthen employee engagement through automated celebrations (birthdays, anniversaries, milestones), peer recognition systems, team connection rituals, and integrated internal communications. The platform integrates with major HRIS systems like Rippling, Workday, and BambooHR to streamline culture-building across distributed teams.

## Key Topics

- Employee Engagement
- Peer Recognition
- Slack Integration
- Teams Integration
- Employee Celebrations
- Onboarding Journeys

## Celebrate Moments & Milestones

- [Celebrate Moments & Milestones - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/celebrate-moments): Celebrate Moments feature: automate birthdays, anniversaries, and milestone celebrations.
- [Celebrate Employee Birthdays - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/celebrate-moments/birthdays): Birthday celebrations in Slack/Teams: automated, personal, and engaging recognition.
- [Celebrate Work Anniversaries in Slack & Teams - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/celebrate-moments/work-anniversaries): Work anniversary automation: messages, collages, nudges, and rewards in Slack/Teams.
- [Celebrate Holidays & Awareness Days - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/celebrate-moments/holidays-awareness-days): Holiday and awareness day celebrations: inclusive announcements and team reminders.
- [Celebrate What Makes Your Company Unique - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/celebrate-moments/custom-celebrations): Custom celebrations: create personalized recognition for projects, launches, and traditions.

## Team Connection & Engagement

- [Spark Connection with Kudos & Team Engagement - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/connection): Connection features: shoutouts, kudos, peer rewards, and team engagement rituals.
- [Shoutouts in Slack & Teams: Peer Recognition Made Simple - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/connection/shoutouts-kudos): Shoutouts/Kudos: customizable peer recognition with rewards tracking in Slack/Teams.
- [Recognition That Employees Can Redeem - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/connection/peer-rewards): Peer Rewards: point-based recognition system with leaderboards and redemption options.
- [Employee Intros in Slack & Teams - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/connection/intros-convo-starters): Employee introductions: automate new hire welcomes and conversation starters.
- [Capture Feedback with Team Surveys and Pulse Checks - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/connection/feedback-surveys): Team surveys and pulse checks: templates and playbooks for feedback collection.
- [Watercooler & Wellness in Slack & Teams - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/connection/watercooler-wellness): Watercooler & Wellness: conversation starters and health tips for team connection.
- [Games in Slack & Teams: Instant Fun and Live Events - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/connection/games-live-events): Games and live events: trivia, Pictionary, and immersive games for team morale.

## Internal Communications & Operations

- [Communicate Clearly with Internal Comms Made Simple - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/communicate-clearly): Internal communications: onboarding, AI assistant, manager tools, and HRIS reporting.
- [Onboarding & Employee Journeys in Slack / Teams - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/communicate-clearly/onboarding-journeys): Onboarding journeys: automated workflows and milestone tracking in Slack/Teams.
- [AI Employee Assistant for Slack & Teams - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/communicate-clearly/ai-assistant): AI Employee Assistant: automate FAQs and knowledge base for team support.
- [Reporting & HRIS Sync - CultureBot](https://getculturebot.com/features/communicate-clearly/reporting-hris-sync): HRIS integration and reporting: sync with Rippling, Workday, BambooHR, Justworks.
